user.title: Inventory
user.description: Inventory per location (freezer, fridge, cellar ...) with a code and optionally a label per item. Set up locations, categories, QR codes and printers afterwards via Configure. If the old Vriezer integration is still there, its settings and stock are taken over.

data.melden_aan: Phone for notifications after a scan

data_description.qr: Puts a QR code on the label (can be switched per category). Scanning it with a phone running the HA app opens the page or sends a notification.
data_description.melden_aan: Normally the notification goes to the phone that scanned. Pick a phone here if that does not work.
data_description.dashboard: For example /lovelace/voorraad. Empty = no Open button.
data_description.bij_scannen: Opening the page only works with the Android app; an iPhone always gets the notification. Ignoring a notification changes nothing.

data_description.naam: For example Freezer, Fridge, Cellar, Pantry.
data_description.invriezen: On: the date is the freeze date plus the days of the category. Off: every item needs a best-before date.

locatie_verwijderen.title: Delete location
locatie_verwijderen.description: Only possible when no category uses this location.

data_description.prefix: 1 to 3 letters for the code, e.g. M gives M-0012. Cannot be changed later.
data_description.dagen: Only for a freezer location: 'use before' is the freeze date plus these days. Elsewhere you enter the best-before date.
data_description.label: Off: no label goes to the queue (e.g. for tins in the cellar).
data_description.qr: Only works when QR codes are also on under General.

categorie_verwijderen.title: Delete category
categorie_verwijderen.description: Only possible when nothing of that category is in stock.

labelprinter.title: Label printer
labelprinter.description: Every label is drawn as a black and white PNG and its path is passed to an action, so any label printer with an HA action that prints an image works. Leave the action empty to only fire the event voorraad_label (with code, product, file) for your own automation.

data_description.label_veld: Name of the field in that action that gets the path.
data_description.label_extra: Sent along as a JSON object, e.g. with dichtheid 2 for Fichero.
data_description.label_breedte: In printer dots. Fichero D11s (30 x 14 mm): 240 x 96.
data_description.label_pauze: Wait before the next label. The Fichero gets confused when labels follow each other quickly; 5 s works. Other printers: 0.

bonprinter.title: Receipt printer
bonprinter.description: Prints an overview of the inventory on a receipt. The text is passed to an action, e.g. of an ESC/POS integration. Empty = only the event voorraad_bon (with the text).

data_description.bon_actie: For example the print text action of your receipt printer integration. To test: persistent_notification.create with field message.

error.name_taken: This name already exists or is empty
error.prefix_taken: These code letters are already in use
error.unknown_action: This action does not exist in HA
error.bad_json: Not a valid JSON object (between curly braces)
error.category_in_use: There is still stock of this category
error.last_category: At least one category must remain
error.location_in_use: A category still uses this location; move it first
error.last_location: At least one location must remain

options.openen: Open the page with the item right away
options.beide: Open the page and send a notification

toevoegen.name: Add
toevoegen.description: Puts one or more items in stock. Each item gets a code; for a category with labels the label goes to the queue (or is printed right away with print).

categorie.name: Category
categorie.description: Name or code letter; empty = the first category.

product.name: Product
product.description: For example Minced beef. Remembered for next time.

hoeveelheid.name: Amount per item
hoeveelheid.description: For example 400 g, 1 kg or 3 pcs.

regel.name: Line
regel.description: Instead of product and amount: 'Mince - 400 g' or 'Mince 400g'.

pakjes.name: Number
pakjes.description: Each item gets its own code (and label).

houdbaar_tot.name: Best before
houdbaar_tot.description: Required outside a freezer. In a freezer: empty = freeze date plus the days of the category.

printen.name: Print now
printen.description: Otherwise the label goes to the queue.

van_boodschappenlijst.name: From shopping list
van_boodschappenlijst.description: Puts a line from a to-do list (e.g. the butcher) in stock and ticks it off there with 'naar <location>'.

houdbaar_tot.name: Best before
houdbaar_tot.description: Required when the category is not in a freezer.

printen.name: Print now
printen.description: Otherwise the label goes to the queue.

uithalen.name: Take out
uithalen.description: Takes an item out of stock, completely or in part.

hoeveelheid.name: Amount taken
hoeveelheid.description: For example 200 g. Empty (and no rest) = everything.

rest.name: Amount left
rest.description: Instead of the amount taken: what is left, e.g. 200 g.

wijzigen.name: Edit
wijzigen.description: Changes product, description, amount, category or dates of an item.

hoeveelheid.name: Amount
hoeveelheid.description: What is there now, e.g. 300 g; empty = unknown.

categorie.name: Category
categorie.description: Move to another category (and so location).

verwijderen.name: Delete
verwijderen.description: Deletes an item completely, without history (for mistakes). Used up: use Take out.

labels_printen.name: Print labels
labels_printen.description: Prints the labels in the queue, or those of the given codes (also again).

codes.name: Codes
codes.description: Empty = the whole queue; otherwise e.g. V-0004, V-0005.

uit_wachtrij.name: Remove from queue
uit_wachtrij.description: Marks labels as printed without printing.

bon_printen.name: Overview on receipt
bon_printen.description: Prints the inventory on the receipt printer; the response holds the text.

product_vergeten.name: Forget product
product_vergeten.description: Removes a product from the list of suggested products.

importeren.name: Import
importeren.description: Takes over items from to-do lists (line 'Product - amount', description 'V-0001 | ingevroren dd/mm/yyyy', due date = best before).
